title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering during regional failover
author: Anita Patel
description: Motivation: incidents over last 48 hours showed the SLO enforcer could thrash across regions during transient capacity drops, causing repeated regional failovers and excessive load-shedding. Root cause: an ordering race between backoff timer updates and circuit-breaker quorum transitions caused stale backoff values to be applied and prevented hysteresis from holding. This change introduces a small synchronous state transition path for the SLO enforcer to ensure atomic updates to backoff/hysteresis state, adds a per-model hysteresis window to reduce flip-flops, and sanitizes ordering in the regional failover decision path. Additionally, we add metrics and unit/integration tests to prevent regressions. Risk: low but touches SLO enforcer state machine; planned roll-out: immediate hotfix with observability enabled and a short canary window. Checklist: 1) reproduce race locally with perf-canary harness 2) add unit tests for ordering 3) add integration test in perf-canary 4) monitor canary metrics and rollback plan documented.
